title: Hooch hounds and pot hounds on the band bus
summary: The bus divided into drinkers in back and pot smokers in front; no separate car for the leader.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: -- not just a musical education, eh?
The bus was divided into two parts: the hooch hounds and the pot hounds.
The back of the bus drank alcohol; the front of the bus smoked pot. [laughter] You know. Yeah, yeah.
And everybody traveled on the bus together? There was no -­
Everybody was on the bus together.
-- separate car for the leader or anything like that?

Separate car? I mean, we got one funky bus. [laughter] Yeah, you know, yeah. Yep! And we used to get the bus from Jersey, you know, the bus company over there. But Eppy was a nice guy, though. I'll tell you one thing that reminded. There was a guy by the name of -- you know there was a -­ the Shaw Agency [phonetic sp.] -­
